children: Over 150 companies turn ex-dividend or undergo stock splits this week (September 21–25). Investors must hold shares in their demat account by each company's record date to qualify — a reminder that timing, not just ownership, decides eligibility. (Image: AI generated)

Maharashtra Scooters leads Monday's record date list with a dividend of ₹160 per share — the single highest payout of the week. Dixon Technologies (₹10) and defence major Bharat Dynamics (₹0.4) also turn ex-date. (Image: AI generated)

Beyond the top payout, Kingfa Science & Technology (₹20), Vedant Fashions (₹7.75), and Container Corporation of India (₹1) are among 55+ companies with Monday record dates — spanning sectors from chemicals to logistics. (Image: Kingfa Science & Technology, Container Corporation of India)
IRCTC and BEML headline Tuesday's list of 50+ stocks. GOCL Corporation tops the payout table at ₹30 per share, followed by BEML (₹12.28) and National Peroxide (₹7). (Image: IRCTC)

Alongside dividends, TAAL Tech will turn ex-record date for a 1:5 stock split on Tuesday — a reminder that record dates aren't just about dividend cheques, but also share count changes. (Image: TAAL Tech)

Gujarat Mineral Development Corporation (GMDC) leads Wednesday's 40+ company list with a final dividend of ₹9.5 per share, followed by Tyche Industries (₹3.5) and Goodluck India (₹3). (Image: AI Generated)
Only two companies fix Thursday as their record date: Engineers India (₹2.5 per share) and Adtech Systems (₹1.1 per share) — a lighter day compared to the rest of the week. (Image: AI Generated)

Six stocks turn ex-date Friday. Sri Lotus Developers and Realty leads dividend payouts at ₹0.5 per share, while Midwest Energy (1:10) and Naturite Agro Products (1:2) undergo stock splits — closing out a packed week of corporate actions. (Image: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty, Midwest Energy)

title: 150+ stocks turn ex-date this week: Key dividends & splits to watch
